name: tether
description: AI control plane over local network

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @tether/server" "npm run dev -w @tether/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tether/client && npm run build -w @tether/server
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run start -w @tether/server" "npm run start -w @tether/client"
scripts.update: git pull origin main && npm i
